title: PLA
description: This mod adds plastic into minecraft! A dirty desert, a 3D printer for special crafting, and tupperware!
body:
# PLA
PLA, or _plastic_, allows you to craft and collect a variety of plastic-themed items, including reusable water bottles, colorful Tupperware containers, decorative plastic blocks, and much more. Whether you're looking to decorate your builds, add modern household items, or simply have fun with a new material!

Features include:
 - Reusable water bottles
 - Tupperware containers
 - Decorative plastic building blocks
 - Multiple colors and variants
 - 3D Printers
 - and even more planned in the future...

[Curseforge Page](https://www.curseforge.com/minecraft/mc-mods/pla)
